_comment: Observation glow FEEL (see include/Glimmer.h): fade + breathe only. The glow hints at an OBSERVABLE spot while it's the active target (you're in reach / hovering); nothing lingers once you step away. Peak BRIGHTNESS is NOT here -- it's the Perception formula in config/formulas.json (the stat drives the glow, same for every spot). Items are NOT glowed (floor icon + rim outline). Tunable -- edit + relaunch (dev reads assets from source). Mirrors config/head_marker.json.
